name: codex-usage
description: Rate-limited Codex usage snapshots and cross-task insights.

interface.shortDescription: Usage snapshots, quota pace, and top tasks.
interface.longDescription: Private, local usage snapshots for Codex. Rate-limited cards appear near active turns and retain their original header values. Expand one to load its cross-task details once, including context pressure, recent token processing, cache reuse, child-task usage, account reset timing, projected pace, and the tasks responsible for the most activity. Data stays on your Mac.
defaultPrompt: Am I on pace to hit my Codex limit?
Which tasks used the most this window?
